questions.q: What does Rick Rubin say you cannot control?
questions.why: Rubin notes that you can't control the audience's reaction.

questions.q: How does Steven Pressfield suggest using repeated failure?
a: As an inflection point to change plans
As a sign to keep doing the same thing
questions.why: Pressfield advises treating failure as a signal to adjust your approach.

questions.q: What habit does Tim Ferriss recommend to avoid bad commitments?
a: Finding new ways to say no
questions.why: He suggests consistently finding new ways to say no to stay selective.

questions.q: What should you do before accepting advice, according to Ferriss?
a: Check potential reasons not to follow it
questions.why: He urges evaluating possible downsides before deciding to use advice.

questions.q: What type of advice does Ferriss say most people receive?
questions.why: He notes a culture of glorified advice that rarely fits the individual.
